trail.name: Heron Pond - Swan Lake Loop Trail
trail.coordinateNote: Official NPS Colter Bay Trailhead marker, 43.8-71.6 m from the two reviewed USGS route endpoints in the Colter Bay access area. Used for an area forecast, not navigation or a claim of identical conditions across the loop.

additionalSources.note: Official NPS route-map configuration identifies the Heron Pond-Swan Lake itinerary and its Colter Bay trailhead layer.
Official NPS connector geometry completes the pond-to-lake route where the current USGS layer has no matching segment.

comparison.note: Seven NPS-origin USGS segments plus the official NPS pond-to-lake connector total about 3.043 miles, 1.8% below the NPS 3.1-mile value. The comparison excludes short unmeasured access inside the Colter Bay parking area.

photo.alt: The Teton Range reflects in Heron Pond beyond lily pads and pine trees.
photo.permissionNote: The official activity page credits C. Adams for NPS and displays no third-party restriction. Retain the credit and source link; no endorsement is implied.
